styles.name: natural
styles.about: Plain, relaxed movement with no character to it. The free sets' neutral takes.
includes: relaxed walking and running with no acted style

styles.name: range-of-motion
styles.about: A body moving each joint through its reach, so the model knows what a body can do.
includes: arm, leg, spine and neck sweeps
leaves_out: moves with a purpose: those have their own style

styles.name: walk
styles.about: Upright walking with empty hands, in any direction.
leaves_out: limps and acted walks: an add-on

styles.name: run
styles.about: Upright jogging, running and sprinting with empty hands.

styles.name: idle
styles.about: Standing in place, not doing anything in particular.

styles.name: jump
styles.about: Leaving the ground on purpose and landing on the feet.
includes: jumps on the spot and running jumps
take-off, air and landing as separate clips

styles.name: fall
styles.about: Losing balance or going down, and getting back up.
leaves_out: landing from a jump on the feet: jump

styles.name: crouch
styles.about: Knees bent and body low, still or moving, with empty hands.
includes: going down into and up out of a crouch
leaves_out: a weapon in hand, which most of these packs have

styles.name: gesture
styles.about: Talking and everyday hand actions while standing or sitting.
includes: picking things up, pressing buttons, using a desk

styles.name: climb
styles.about: Getting over or up something with hands and feet.
leaves_out: flips on the way over: acrobatic

styles.name: zombie
styles.about: A way of moving: lurching, dragging, losing control of the body.
leaves_out: feeding and eating, which aren't a way of moving
attacks that need a second person

styles.name: acrobatic
styles.about: The body leaves its normal upright balance on purpose and comes back to it.
leaves_out: tricks on a motorbike or skates
